# Remove unused local variable `config` (F841) in proxy/tests/test_cold_start_immunity.py

## Problem statement

Ruff reports an F841 finding in `proxy/tests/test_cold_start_immunity.py`: in
`test_cold_start_503_remote_still_quarantines`, the local variable `config` is
assigned via `_local_config()` but never used (the `_handle_http_error_with_cooldown`
call for a remote provider deliberately does not pass `config`, since remote
providers are never cold-start immune). The dead assignment should be removed.

## Users

- **Developer / maintainer** — wants a clean Ruff pass (`ruff check` green) on the
  cold-start immunity test module introduced by LP-0MVAYO1ZM005ZWTF.
- **CI / linter gate** — F841 findings surface as lint noise in the refactor
  pipeline automatically created by the refactor skill.

Example user story: "As a developer merging the cold-start immunity tests
(LP-0MVAYO1ZM005ZWTF), I want no unused local variables in
`test_cold_start_immunity.py`, so the file passes `ruff check` cleanly."

## Acceptance Criteria

- Remove the unused `config = _local_config()` local assignment inside
  `test_cold_start_503_remote_still_quarantines` in
  `proxy/tests/test_cold_start_immunity.py` (line 170 in the current dev checkout;
  reported as line 164 in the now-deleted worktree).
- `ruff check proxy/tests/test_cold_start_immunity.py` reports no F841 for the
  `config` variable. (Note: two other, unrelated F841 findings — `cooldown` at
  ~line 175 and `loaded_at` at ~line 318 — may still be reported; they are out of
  scope for this item and tracked separately.)
- No functional behaviour change: the test still asserts the remote provider is
  quarantined during the cold window, with the failure counter bumped.
- Full project test suite passes with the change (via `/skill:test`).
- All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code
  comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries.

## Constraints

- The path in the auto-created item title/description references a deleted
  worktree (`wl-LP-0MVAYO1ZM005ZWTF-…`). The file now permanently lives in the
  main checkout at `proxy/tests/test_cold_start_immunity.py` (committed by
  LP-0MVAYO1ZM005ZWTF, ee6c42b5) — the fix must be made there.
- Keep the change surgical: remove only the dead `config` assignment. Do not pass
  `config` into the remote-provider call, as that would change the test's intent
  (remote providers must remain non-immune).
- Do not expand scope to the other two F841 findings in the same file.

## Existing state

- `proxy/tests/test_cold_start_immunity.py` — 15-test module verifying ACs a–e of
  LP-0MVAYO1ZM005ZWTF (grace-period immunity for local cold-start 503s).
  `test_cold_start_503_remote_still_quarantines` creates `config` but never uses
  it; the remote call intentionally omits `config`.
- The parent (LP-0MVAYO1ZM005ZWTF) is completed and pushed to dev; the worktree
  has been cleaned up.

## Desired change

Remove the single dead line `config = _local_config()` in
`test_cold_start_503_remote_still_quarantines`. Optionally retitle
LP-0MVB0THT7000KT0G to the canonical path (the current title says "Unused Import"
and carries the deleted worktree path, though the finding is an unused variable).

## Risks & assumptions

- **Scope creep:** two sibling F841 findings remain in the same file (`cooldown` ~line 175, `loaded_at` ~line 318). They are separate lint findings, not covered by this item; fixing them here would expand scope. Created as follow-up opportunities only if the producer asks.
- **Intent guard (high):** passing `config` to the remote-provider call instead of removing it would silently weaken the test — remote providers must stay non-immune. The fix is removal only.
- **Line drift:** reported line 164 was in the deleted worktree; dev checkout has the assignment at line 170. Locate by variable name (`config = _local_config()` inside `test_cold_start_503_remote_still_quarantines`), not by line number.
- **Assumption:** removing the dead assignment cannot break the test — verified reading the test body (the remote call does not reference `config`) and the helper `_local_config()` is used by many other tests, so no dead helper.

## Key Files

- `proxy/tests/test_cold_start_immunity.py` — remove unused `config` local in `test_cold_start_503_remote_still_quarantines` (line 170).

## Related work

- LP-0MVAYO1ZM005ZWTF — "Tests: grace-period immunity for local cold-start 503s" (completed; source of this file).
- LP-0MVAYO1GD002CDVJ — "Implementation: grace-period immunity" (completed; adds cold-start deferral to `_handle_http_error_with_cooldown`; `config` param plumbed, default `None`).
- LP-0MV9UNIOZ009RIAN — parent epic "Implement grace-period immunity…".
- Precedent: sibling auto-created F841 items (e.g. LP-0MTDJ48EJ006XTAL, LP-0MTDJ493M006PQ3B) closed by removing the dead local via `ruff --fix`.
